articles.title: Jammu Kashmir Power Development Department Orders Transfer and Posting of Engineers - Kashmir Life
articles.full_text:
SRINAGAR: The Jammu and Kashmir Government has ordered the immediate transfer and posting of a large number of engineers in the Power Development Department (PDD) as part of administrative arrangements for the smooth functioning of official work.
The transfers and postings were ordered under Government Order No. 181-JK(PDD) of 2026, dated August 20, 2026, issued by Ashwani Kumar, IAS, Financial Commissioner (Additional Chief Secretary), PDD.
Among the officers holding the charge of Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE), Anita Devi has been posted as Technical Officer (T.O.) to the Executive Engineer, ED-II, JPDCL, while Mohammad Rafiq Rather has been posted as T.O. to the Executive Engineer, ED-III, KPDCL, Srinagar.
Raja Imran Ali Khan (ST) has been transferred to SD-Hawal, ED-IV, KPDCL, and Mohammad Ayoob Bhat to SD-Tral, ED-Awantipora, KPDCL. Ajay Kumar has been posted to SD-Vijaypur, ED-Vijaypur, JPDCL, while Gulshan Toga (SC) has been posted to SD-Akhnoor, ED-III, JPDCL.
Shakoor Ahmad Bhat has been transferred to SD-II, TLMD-II (Awantipora), JKPTCL, Kashmir. Mohd Iqbal Mir has been posted to SD-North, Electric Central Store Division, KPDCL, while Aadil Mehraj Wani has been posted to SD-II, ED-Sopore, KPDCL.
Mohammad Imran Farooq has been posted to SD-Store/T.O., ED-II, KPDCL, while Mir, I/c AEE, has been posted as T.O. to the Executive Engineer, ED-Anantnag, Kulgam, KPDCL.
Rayees Ahmad Malla, I/c AEE, has been transferred to SD-Banihal, Batote, JPDCL. Syed Anees Ur Rehman, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-(Technical Section) Pulwama, STD-SD-Pampore, ED-Awantipora, Pulwama, KPDCL.
Showkat Mushtaq has been posted as T.O. to the Superintending Engineer, O and M Circle Bijbehara, KPDCL, while Ahmad Hussain Ganai has been posted as T.O. to the Superintending Engineer, O&M Circle Awantipora, KPDCL.
Peerzada Zia-ur-Rehman, I/c AEE, has been transferred to SD-Pulwama, ED-Pulwama, KPDCL. Sumir Sharma, I/c AEE, has been posted as T.O. to the Executive Engineer, STD-Kathua, JPDCL.
Kulbeer Singh, I/c AEE, has been posted to the office of the Chief Engineer, Planning and Procurement, KPDCL, Technical Section.
Ghulam Mohd Mir, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-Rajpura, ED-Pulwama, KPDCL, in place of Ajaz Mudasir, I/c AEE. Ajaz Mudasir has, in turn, been transferred to the Electric Central Store Division, KPDCL.
Tahoor Hassan Pandit, I/c AEE, has been placed on deputation to JKPDC.
Parshotam Lal Sharma, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-III, STD-I, JPDCL, in place of Rohit Kumar Gupta, I/c AEE. Gupta has been transferred to SD-Jourian, ED-III, JPDCL, in place of Parshotam Lal Sharma.
Balvinder Arora, I/c AEE, has been posted to ED-Reasi, SD-Katra, JPDCL, while Khurshid Ahmad Bhat, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-Streetlight, ED-II, KPDCL.
Garu Ram, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-I, STD-I, JPDCL, Jammu, in place of Pardeep Singh, I/c AEE. Pardeep Singh has been transferred to the Project Wing, Jammu, JPDCL.
Yaseer Ahmad Kakroo, I/c AEE, has been assigned additional charge of AEE, SD-I, ED-Baramulla, KPDCL.
Nisar Ahmad Bulla, I/c AEE, has been posted as T.O. to the Superintending Engineer, Circle-II, KPDCL, while Asif Nazir Bhat, I/c AEE, has been transferred to TLMD-VI, JKPTCL.
Mohd Nadeem Tahir, I/c AEE, has been transferred to SD-Plant, ED-Rajouri, JPDCL, relieving Zia-ul-Hafiz.
Wajid Ahmad Khan, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-Ashwagam, ED-Bijbehara, KPDCL, in place of Bashir Ahmad Bhat, I/c AEE. Bashir Ahmad Bhat has been transferred to SD-Kulgam, STD-Bijbehara, KPDCL.
Abdul Hamid Ganai, I/c AEE, has been transferred to SD-Trehgam, ED-Kupwara, KPDCL, in place of Sajid Iqbal Mir, AEE. Sajid Iqbal Mir, I/c AEE, has been posted to SD-Kupwara, ED-Kupwara, KPDCL, in place of Abdul Hamid Ganai.
Ashraf Ganai, I/c AEE, has been posted as T.O. to the Superintending Engineer, Circle-I, KPDCL.
Mohd Awan Shazia Ali, I/c AEE, has been placed on deputation to JKPDC for further posting in LJHEP.
Abdul Hamid, I/c AEE, has been posted to the Procurement Circle, JPDCL, Jammu.
Shazia Basharat, I/c AEE, has been transferred to SLDC Srinagar, JKPTCL, in place of Shah Hanan, I/c AEE. Shah Hanan has been posted to SD-II, Inspection Division Kashmir, in place of Shazia Basharat.
The order also covers Assistant Engineers. Satvinder Kour, I/c AE, has been posted to ECWD, Jammu, while Amit Sharma, I/c AE, has been transferred to TLMD-V (Hiranagar), SD-II, JKPTCL, Jammu.
Vikram Gupta, I/c AE, has been posted to SD-Plant, ED-I, JPDCL, Jammu. Masood Ahmad, I/c AE, has been posted to SD-Dooru, ED-Anantnag, KPDCL, while Nazir Ahmad Ganai, I/c AE, has been posted as AE (Plant), ED-Anantnag, KPDCL.
Surinder Kumar, I/c AE, has been posted to SD-III, STD-I, JPDCL. Irfan Bashir Magray, I/c AE, has been transferred to SD-Ramban, ED-Batote, JPDCL, in place of Surinder Kumar.
All the engineers covered by the order have been deemed to have been relieved from their existing assignments with immediate effect.
